verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community remark confirming that a Copilot AI integration exists inside Outlook; the same user found it slower than copy-pasting into another client. There are no first-party docs describing what tasks Copilot can take on, and the Graph API docs describe developer building blocks, not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the built-in assistant, evidence of which tasks can be delegated (drafting, triage, scheduling), and hands-on corroboration that delegation works well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
